fixes.where: assets/css/site.css .hero__tint (the 'tint grades the loop' rule) / index.html header over the hero
fixes.what: Add a top scrim as a second background layer: linear-gradient(rgba(27,34,30,.55) 0, rgba(27,34,30,0) 180px) above the existing .34→.66 ramp, so the bar's links, the gold (925) number and the envelope sit on cypress at scroll 0.
fixes.why: In index-desktop-0 the gold number and parchment links sit on the loop's white drapery; gold on near-white is ~1.8:1 and the night-first rule is lost on the first glance.

fixes.what: Deepen the halo: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(27,34,30,.85), rgba(27,34,30,.5) 55%, transparent 80%), height 190%→230%.
fixes.why: The thin Persian kashida stroke under ANAR EVENTS runs across the pale roses in the footage (desktop-0, y≈450) and nearly vanishes; the logo must read plainly as one mark, Latin and Persian.

fixes.what: Finish the deepen earlier: duration 1 → 0.8 (solid cypress by 80 % of the hero), so the fixed video is gone before the canopy's underside and the statement arrive.
fixes.why: index-desktop-1 shows a faint lighter rectangle (the ghosted table) between the trunks behind 'Reimagined Heritage'; the open middle must be clean night, not a muddy patch.

fixes.what: Replace text-wrap:balance with display:block;max-width:20ch;margin-inline:auto so the caps line breaks at the full stop ('HONORING THE ROOTS.' / 'ELEVATING THE VIBE.').
fixes.why: index-phone-0 breaks the owner's line as 'ELEVATING / THE VIBE.', a widow on the brand statement.
index-phone-1 leaves 'realized.' and 'minute.' as one-word orphans under the three promises; the ruled-band device looks careless with a dangling word.

fixes.what: Add an inner-edge shade layer over the tile: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(27,34,30,0) 9%, rgba(27,34,30,.35) 12.8%, rgba(27,34,30,.35) 87.2%, rgba(27,34,30,0) 91%) so each trunk darkens toward the open middle and reads as a round trunk.
fixes.why: index-desktop-3 shows the tiled band as two soft flat curtains, noticeably less painterly than the crisp canopy and roots on the screens around it.
